ques: I want a Cabernet Sauvignon priced under $20 a bottle. Compare the two cheapest Cabernet Sauvignons the site sells — their prices and their customer ratings — then buy 3 bottles of the cheaper one as a guest, going all the way to the order confirmation. Report both wines with prices and ratings, which one you bought, the order number, and the total.

As a guest (do not sign in), buy 3 bottles of the 2023 Time & Tide Chardonnay Monterey County: find it, add it to your cart, and complete the full checkout with your own details. Along the way, note whether this order gets free shipping. Report the order number, the total, and the shipping charge.

In the Shop All Wine collection, use the filters to show only red wines from Spain. From the filtered list, pick the wine with the highest customer rating, open its page to double-check that rating, and buy 3 bottles of it as a guest. Report how many wines the filters leave, the wine you picked with its rating, the order number, and the total.

I'm deciding between the two case sizes of the Golden State Essentials Case. Compare the 6-pack and the 12-pack on their case prices and their per-bottle prices, and buy the size with the lower per-bottle price. Report both case prices with their per-bottle prices, which size you bought, what's inside the case, the order number, and the total.

I live in Utah. I wanted the 2023 Time & Tide Pinot Noir Monterey County — check what the site says about shipping that wine to Utah. Then find a red wine the site can actually ship to Utah, and buy 3 bottles of it, completing checkout with a Utah address. Report what happened with the first wine, the red wine you bought, the order number, and the total.

Log in with the demo account (email: bob.c@test.com, password: TestPass123!). Check the address and the card saved on your account, then add 2 more bottles of the 2021 Valanda Tempranillo to your cart and check out with your saved details. Report the city of the saved address, the order number, and the order total.

Log in with the demo account (email: carol.d@test.com, password: TestPass123!). Add a second shipping address to your account: Kayla Davis, 118 Larimer St, Apt 4, Denver, CO 80204, phone (303) 555-0148. Then check out your cart shipping to this new address, paying with a new card: 5555 4444 3333 2222, exp 08/2028, holder Carol Davis, CVC 456. Report the order number and the total.

As a guest, add 2 bottles of the 2021 Valanda Tempranillo to your cart and look at what the cart page says about its checkout minimum and about free shipping. Then adjust the quantity until checkout unlocks, keep adding bottles until free shipping is unlocked, and place the order. Report both rules the cart page shows you, the order number, and the total.

Log in with the demo account (email: david.k@test.com, password: TestPass123!). Find the order you are still waiting on (the one not yet delivered), note its number and total, then reorder exactly that item: remove anything else from your cart so the new order contains only it, and complete the purchase. Report the old order number with its total and the new order number with its total.

I'm sending a friend a $100 gift card and want a sparkling wine under $30 for the toast. Buy the gift card and one sparkling bottle as a guest, open the cart, and if the site's minimum-bottle rule blocks checkout, add what's needed to pass it, then complete the order. Report whether the gift card counted toward the minimum, what you ordered, the order number, and the total.

Compare the three Wine Club case options — Mixed, All Reds, All Whites — on how many wines and bottles each includes and the intro case price. Read the FAQ for the renewal price, how often shipments arrive, and the customer support phone number. My spouse drinks reds only, so also order the Cellar Select: Merlot 3-Pack as a first taste. Report the club facts plus the order number and total.

Read the Wine 101 guide about wine storage temperatures. Following its long-term storage advice, report the ideal storage temperature it gives, the humidity range it recommends, and the full-bodied reds it names. Then buy 3 bottles of one of those full-bodied reds as a guest, for your home cellar. Report the wine you chose, the order number, and the total.

I'm choosing between two award winners: the 2024 House Party Moscato and the 2024 Misirlou Chardonnay. Compare their medals, the awarding competitions, and their ABV, then buy 6 bottles of the cheaper one as a guest — enough to unlock the site's free shipping — and complete the order. Report both wines' awards and ABV, which one you bought, the order number, and the total.

Find the Chardonnay with the most customer reviews on this site. Open its page and read its review summary — the average rating, how many reviews it has, and the percentage of reviewers who would recommend it — then buy 3 bottles as a guest. Report the wine with its rating facts, the order number, and the total.

Log in with the demo account (email: carol.d@test.com, password: TestPass123!). Change your account password to AutumnCellar77! and then report whether the account page confirms the change; then change it back to TestPass123! and confirm you can still sign out and back in with the original password.

Register a brand new account on the site (invent a name and an email you have not used before; use the password CellarDoor88!), then add 3 bottles of the 2023 Closed Window Pinot Noir Willamette Valley to your cart, place the order with your own details, and report the new order number and total.
